episodes.final_message: Since I don't have your recent sleep or stress check-ins from the last few days, and I know you have coursework deadlines today during midterm week, I want to check in. How are your energy and stress levels holding up this evening?

It sounds like you're carrying a heavy load right now with multiple deadlines today and feeling that intense loneliness. Please remember you don't have to navigate this alone—Dartmouth's Counseling and Human Development at Dick's House ((603) 646-9442) offers free, confidential support and after-hours care, and the 988 Lifeline (call or text 988) is always available 24/7. For tonight, please give yourself permission to step away from your coursework, take a few deep breaths, and get some rest.
